Comes from new recipe that appears after you report Lighthouse of Alexandria (need to reach the deepest part of Sea of Wonders) from Ibn in Alexandria.

Recipe Name : Hyper Seraphim (18)
Skill Reqs : Casting Rank 15
Ingredients : Seraphim (12) + 5x Strange Cannon + Set of Repair Tools

Stats :
80/80 Durability
Maximum PP points (according to JP wiki) 1098
Range 500
Speed 7
Burst 3
Reload 4
